c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Cycle 4 = refine; user directive: take the remaining spec-level opens ONE AT A TIME, widest-impact first, so nothing gets re-interrogated later. Order chosen: (1) segmentation/unit-class vocabulary (shared language for capability fits, fingerprint, utility, affinity); (2) FP representativeness + mass inference mechanics; (3) stage-1 product contract details; (4) prototype A/B harness; (5) 2026 sigma posture. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Flavor = refine. User directive: spec-level opens one at a time, widest first. Order: segmentation vocabulary -> FP representativeness/mass -> stage-1 product contract -> prototype A/B -> 2026 sigma posture.

q1.title: Segmentation vocabulary: how are unit classes defined
q1.imperative: Pin the shared segmentation vocabulary: property-based classes (measured apex-speed bands, brake/traction phases) vs geometric corner identity; class count vs per-weekend sample support; continuous descriptors underneath. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q1.finding: SEGMENTATION DECIDED: property-based classes with continuous substrate CONFIRMED (per-corner identity = way too little data). REFINEMENT (user): corners are MIXTURES over property classes - fractional/soft membership (T13 might be 0.6 classA + 0.4 classB), giving reusable correlation structure rather than one-corner-one-property. Prework falling out: identify what turns decompose into which property mixtures. Storage grain = continuous descriptors; classes = re-cuttable view; observability routing per class; class count support-driven.

q2.title: FP representativeness + per-lap mass inference mechanics
q2.imperative: Pin how run purpose, mass, and engine mode are inferred per FP lap and how representativeness weights are produced. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q2.finding: FP MECHANICS CONFIRMED dead-on (per-lap latents m/engine-mode/purpose, observed compound, grip-anchored decomposition, representativeness weights, sandbag->wider sigma not bias). ADDITIONS (user): (1) run-order honesty - expect to run after FP1 with huge sigma, FP2 adds little, FP3 adds a lot; fine, just be honest. (2) INTER-SESSION PROCESS NOISE: car state evolves between practices (teams tweak/learn/react) - carry setup-change uncertainty as process noise on a session-indexed car-state chain FP1->FP2->FP3->Q; teams usually improve through the weekend but not guaranteed (one-off experiments happen). (3) PARC FERME STEP: teams adjust between FP3 and quali; how well a team converts information into a step (Red Bull famously good) is itself a team quality = a learnable per-team FP3->Q reaction distribution; mechanistically easy in our data per user.

q3.title: Stage-1 product contract: what it emits, at what grain
q3.imperative: Pin the emit contract: records, grain (constructor vs driver vs lap), covariance completeness, versioning, as-of semantics. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q3.finding: PRODUCT CONTRACT ACCEPTED: 4 record types (weekend-state / car-basis posterior with FULL covariance, session-chained / lap evidence / as-of-stamped feature view for evo), MODEL_VERSION keyed, append-only, evo touches only the feature view. Constructor-grain basis = acceptable round-1 trade. BANKED FUTURE NOTES (user: capture one-offs so they close uncertainty later): (1) account for cars-noted-not-identical (per-entry spec divergence); (2) cross-weekend cross-driver info pulls for staggered upgrades (driver A upgraded this weekend, driver B next). Direction confirmed right.

q4.title: Prototype A/B harness details
q4.imperative: Pin the A/B: baseline bundle, injection toggle mechanism, backtest seasons, gate order and thresholds. Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q4.finding: A/B HARNESS ACCEPTED: baseline = live gold untouched; variant = +physics composite as fusion step behind a manifest toggle (quali_pace_anchor pattern, one boolean); quali task only round 1; scored window 2022-2025 walkforward, 2019-2021 robustness appendix; gates cheap->expensive G0 correlation-with-evo-errors screen / G1 quali sign-acc + Brier vs baseline AND 0.80 ceiling (LOSO + OOS-2025) / G2 fantasy pts/race; as-of honesty measured at three cutoffs (post-FP1/FP2/FP3); dry = scored population, wet flagged; all gates reportable-either-way (no kill switch).

q5.title: 2026 posture: minimum honest handling of active aero
q5.imperative: Pin the 2026 sigma posture: inflation mechanism, decision record, feature-view emission, exit condition (#499/#483). Ask with recommendation; record as finding.
q5.finding: 2026 POSTURE DECIDED (terminology corrected): NOT blanket sigma inflation - a latent-mode two-state fit. Regs verified: exactly two aero modes (Z/Corner = default high-downforce, X/Straight = low drag), NO held neutral; Overtake/Boost = PU not aero. Plan: two-state drag (Z/X analogous to DRS closed/open) fitted jointly sharing P_max; per-sample mode latent with allowance-zone priors (outside zones = Z certain; mid-straight in zone = X high confidence; transition ramps = targeted sigma). DELIVERED DEPS FOUND (user thought delivered - confirmed): active_aero_zones.py allowance reference layer (efb45ba3), active_aero_identification.py CdA evidence scorer (34d465a1), PR #622 RegulationEra 2026 fix + aero_axis_2026 pooled axis (572e685e, tagged #483). No per-car aero-state telemetry channel in 2026 - labels inferred not observed -> #499 AeroDragSet interface should accept SOFT per-sample config probabilities. Status comments posted on #499 + #483 per user authorization (issuecomment-5006070310, -5006070571). cmdr work-area STATE_NOTE is stale (work shipped).

consolidation.summary: Cycle 4 (refine) consolidated - all five spec-level opens pinned one at a time, widest first: (1) segmentation = property-based classes, continuous substrate, SOFT/fractional corner membership (mixtures = reusable correlation story); (2) FP mechanics = per-lap latents (mass/mode/purpose) + observed compound, grip-anchored decomposition, representativeness weights, PLUS session-indexed car-state chain with process noise (teams tweak between sessions) and learnable per-team parc-ferme FP3->Q reaction step; (3) product contract = 4 record types (weekend-state / car-basis full-covariance session-chained / lap evidence / as-of-stamped feature view), constructor grain round-1 trade accepted, banked one-offs list started; (4) A/B harness = live gold vs +physics-fusion-step toggle, quali-only, 2022-2025 scored + 2019-2021 appendix, G0 correlation/G1 sign-acc+Brier/G2 fantasy pts, three as-of cutoffs, dry scored; (5) 2026 = latent-mode two-state Z/X joint fit with allowance-zone priors (deps already delivered), #499/#483 = structural exit, issue comments posted. Board current.
